highlights.title: Setup points to the right place
highlights.line: Creating an agent with no AI account now points you to Settings, AI Models, not an Accounts tab that does not exist.

highlights.title: Agents speak your language
highlights.line: On a Mac set to another language, your agents now start and post in that language instead of English.

highlights.title: Switching to Claude works
highlights.line: Switching an agent to Claude now offers your Claude accounts to pick from, and the panel stops describing the old provider.

highlights.title: See what your agent asks
highlights.line: When Claude Code asks an agent whether to switch models, its page shows the question, not "cannot find the question".

highlights.title: Agents report Kosmos bugs
highlights.line: Agents can post a Kosmos bug report to the Kosmos+ community and are told to leave out your files, logs and screens.
